scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.description: The arithmetic every question is scored inside.
scoring.baseScoreHint: Each question starts here before sections are applied.
scoring.questionMaxHint: A question score is clamped to this range.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.roleHint: Informational inputs are recorded but never scored.
inputs.weightHint: Each unit entered moves the score by this much.

rules.description: When a juror's entry means the normal arithmetic no longer applies.
rules.empty: No override rules. Every question is scored by the section arithmetic alone.
rules.needsInputs: Add a question type with at least one input before creating rules.

adjustments.title: Participant adjustments
adjustments.description: Applied once per participant per jury, not per question.

publish.noChanges: Nothing to publish — the configuration is unchanged.

freeze.title: Freeze configuration
freeze.description: Once frozen, this event's configuration can never be changed again — not even from here. Do this when the competition is about to begin.

create.description: An event and its evaluation rules are created together — an event without rules cannot be scored.
